definitions.explanation: A school club whose members write poetry, short fiction, essays, and similar literary work and typically publish a club magazine.

examples.japanese: {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}に{入|はい}った。
{文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}で{詩|し}を{書|か}いている。
examples.english: I write poetry in the literature club.

examples.japanese: {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}の{部誌|ぶし}に{短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}を{掲載|けいさい}してもらった。
examples.english: I had a short story published in the literature club's magazine.

notes:
Compound of {文芸|ぶんげい} (literary arts) + {部|ぶ} (club). Common at middle schools, high schools, and universities; usually quieter and less athletic in image than sports clubs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}{員|いん}: literature-club member
- {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}の{部誌|ぶし}: literature club's magazine
- {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}の{活動|かつどう}: literature-club activities

RELATED WORDS:
- {新聞部|しんぶんぶ}: newspaper club — focuses on reporting and the school paper
- {演劇部|えんげきぶ}: drama club — performance-oriented
- {国語|こくご}{研究|けんきゅう}{部|ぶ}: Japanese-language study club
